title: Kanekar on the FDE question
html: Kanekar writes from inside the current forward-deployed-engineer hiring wave, and the piece opens with a plain complaint: founders are handing out the FDE title before anyone has agreed on what the job covers. Nearly every conversation about the role runs into the same unresolved question, so the piece takes it head-on instead of dodging it: what actually separates a forward-deployed engineer from a good consultant. Read it for that distinction. It does not catalogue what FDEs do at any particular company; it draws the line between the role and the work it keeps getting mistaken for.
